Added the Foldable devices section against device-input-mapping.ts, device-live-surface-producer.ts and DeviceFoldView/DeviceFoldControls: iOS fold settled by correlated helper reply, lit-display panel stream with main-stream fallback, Android closed/open only via serve-emu /api/fold read on input connect, bent drawing and inverse touch mapping, slider snap within six degrees.
